${UI.esc(String(D.st.jobs | 0))} / ${UI.esc(String(D.st.quests | 0))}${UI.esc(T('подработок / заданий', 'jobs / quests'))}
${UI.esc(T('Кошельки по державам', 'Purses by state'))}

' · ' + TF('дневной заработок {0}', 'a day\'s wage {0}', wkFmtMoney(r.uid, wkWage(st))) : ''))}

${ecoCurIcon(r.uid, 14)}≈ ${r.uid === hu ? '' : UI.esc(local ? wkFmtMoney(hu, local) : '—')}${r.uid === hu ? UI.esc(TF('{0} дн.', '{0} d', r.v.toFixed(1))) : ''}

return h + `

`;

any = true; const g = ecoItem(k), n = ecoInvN(k), arm = g.k === 'armor', on = arm && D.arm === k;

`;

const ammo = WA.mode === 'survival' ? Object.keys(WKP.arms.reserve).map(k => waAmmoName(k) + ' ×' + (WKP.arms.reserve[k] | 0)) : [];

${UI.esc(T('Оружие', 'Weapons'))}
${UI.esc(wp.length ? wp.join(', ') : T('только кулаки — оружие продают в лавках', 'fists only — weapons are sold in shops'))}${ammo.length ? '
' + UI.esc(T('Боеприпасы: ', 'Ammo: ') + ammo.join(', ')) : ''}
`;

`;

${UI.esc(keyTxt(T('‹heal› — быстро подлечиться: съесть самое подходящее из вещей.', '‹heal› — heal quickly: eat the most fitting item from your pack.')))}
`;

function ecoJournalRep() {
const uids = new Set(); for (const k in WKP.rep) if (Math.abs(WKP.rep[k]) >= 0.5) uids.add(+k);
const here = ecoStOf(WK.pl.cell); if (here) uids.add(here.uid);

let h = `
${UI.esc(T('Слава у держав', 'Standing with states'))}
`, worst = here || null;

findings.conclusion: The option is latched at entry. Survival uses owned items and stored ammunition. Armed uses era loadouts and optional assists.
Version 2 saves a roster with independent version 1 profiles. Legacy saves migrate; roster operations use the map UI interlock.
Entry snapshots the shared renderer. Local frames, history time and room time are separate. Spawn, teleport and respawn have distinct contracts.
The movement loop uses local geometry and water. Damage can be changed by modules. Arrest may consume the death action before normal respawn.
World seed and world cells drive local terrain and plans. Accepted signatures protect nearby visible geometry while world state advances.
Damage is replayed from the walk journal for regenerated plans. Strategic map impact is a separate civilization update.
Windows precede registered keys, then vehicle and base actions. Module, actor and body selection have separate thresholds. A pausing journal reads the active profile.

checks.label: Default mode and survival flag normalization
Option-provider errors fall back and armed flags survive
Armed spends no stored ammunition; survival consumes what exists
Removing owned equipment clears its loaded field and returns to fists
Rich payment leaves real balance intact and regular payment debits it
Legacy profile migrates in place and keeps extension values
Creation carries onboarding and sequence but isolates inventory and money
Switch restores the first hero and keeps the second snapshot
World save v2 takes live and inactive data and restores active ID
Active walk rejects roster switching, creation, deletion, reset and UI rename
Reset cleans only active profile and retains tips and quest counter
Deleting active selects its neighbor; last hero cannot be removed
Roster accepts 100 unique valid IDs and falls back to first hero
World generation clears all characters
Entry suspends map pause and creates local clocks, scene and player
World speed is independent from walk clock and pauses locally
Active entry teleports, respects hook and water eligibility
Teleport flushes pending structure, retains HP and consumes spawn callback
Ready gate rejects incomplete chunks and opens after timeout
Respawn searches land villages and emits arrive without replacing session options
Exit restores renderer settings, prior pause and map focus
Walking, sprint, diagonal clamp and carrying use shipped speeds
Window suppresses motion input and crouch reduces speed
Jump launches a living player; an impact above threshold damages
Water activates swim; a sustained dive emits drowning damage
Fallout ticks at the current cell and quiet time later regenerates
Armor runs before HP reduction; god mode restores HP immediately
Lethal damage calls the death hook and opens default UI only if unhandled
Law excludes environmental deaths and intercepts eligible guard deaths
Physical keys, arrows and modifiers normalize to walk tokens
Repeat maintains held state; release and blur clear it
Dialog intercepts digits and E before module or vehicle
Module, vehicle and base action run in priority order
Local time cycles through three modes; room T delegates to host interface
J opens pausing journal at Quests and closes the same window
Four tabs render and task/item actions use current profile handlers
NPC eligibility excludes hostile and rear candidates; E dispatches dialogue
Module target checks reach, elevation and direction and can outrank NPC
Dead, seated or modal player cannot use a target; eligible bodies and carcasses dispatch
Map geometry maps 400 m cells to four 200 m chunks
Seeded generators repeat by world salt and differ with seed or cell
Projected class follows city, inner ring, rural, village and wild tiers
Terrain checksum changes on elevation and ignores population
Visible nearby cell keeps accepted plan; hidden cell accepts new structure
Visible room cell can recolor separately; teleport accepts pending signature
Thin props vanish; wall breaches and roof props topple
Damage persists when the same plan is regenerated, without editing map fields
Visual rebuild waits for the damage deadline and then queues detail
Heavy buildings cap at 12 nearest while thin props use their own branch
Ruined wall keeps a lower obstacle until breached; collapsed house is passable
Shared room clock wraps independently from connection-local walk state
Remote pose payload leaves character profile and session mode out
Armed replaces loadout at a higher tier, keeps gear at lower tier and unions discoveries at equal tier
Spawn planning consumes battle hint and falls back to facility before plaza
Room world jump keeps player coordinates and view even on newly flooded cell
Disposal clears the walk-session damage journal and refresh queue

limitations: VM runs selected functions with substituted DOM, renderer, room interfaces, actors and small world fixtures.
Profile round trips use memory. No user save is opened. Actual pointer lock, complete visual scenes, accessibility and live room synchronization remain unobserved.
Quests, economics, NPC ecology, law, transport and combat are covered only at the core call sites.
